Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 의뢰를 실패한 <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>(은)는 자신이 늦장을 부린 게 원인이라고 자책한다.
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> blames herself for dawdling too long and failing the quest.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: 依頼に失敗した<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は、自分がもたついていたのが原因だと自責している。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 未能完成委托的<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>自责原因是因为自己动作太慢。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: 未能完成委託的<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>自責原因是因為自己動作太慢。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> se reproche d'avoir trop traîné et d'avoir échoué la quête.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: Die Mission ist gescheitert. <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> macht sich selbst Vorwürfe, weil sie zu lange getrödelt hat.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> se culpa por haber tardado demasiado y haber fallado en la misión.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: A <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> que falhou na missão se culpa por ter demorado demais.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ตำหนิตัวเองที่มัวแต่ชักช้าจนทำให้ภารกิจล้มเหลว
Data.UnitTalk_IND: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> menyalahkan dirinya sendiri karena terlalu lama menunda dan gagal dalam misi.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> tự trách bản thân đã chậm trễ, khiến nhiệm vụ thất bại.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> खुद को दोषी ठहराती है कि देर करने की वजह से वह काम में असफल रही।

JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_ENG: It's all right. You did your best.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_JPN: ベストを尽くしたんだ、大丈夫。
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_CHN: 你已经尽力了，没关系的。
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_TWN: 你已經盡力了，沒關係的。
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_FRA: C'est bon. Tu as fait de ton mieux.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_DEU: Es ist in Ordnung. Du hast dein Bestes gegeben.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_ESP: Está bien. Hiciste lo mejor que pudiste.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_PRT: Está tudo bem. Você fez o seu melhor.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_THA: ไม่เป็นไรหรอกครับ/ค่ะ คุณทำดีที่สุดแล้ว
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_IND: Tidak apa-apa. Kamu sudah melakukan yang terbaik.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_VIE: Không sao đâu. Cô đã cố gắng hết sức rồi.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_HIN: तुमने अपना सर्वश्रेष्ठ दिया, इसलिए ठीक है।

JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_JPN: 活力ポーションを渡す。
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_FRA: Une Potion de vitalité a été remise.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_THA: มอบยาเพิ่มพลังชีวิตให้
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_VIE: Đưa ra một Bình Thuốc Sinh Lực.

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: Looking relieved, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> walked away with light, graceful steps.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は、機嫌が直ったのか、軽やかに歩いていった。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>似乎心情好转，轻快地走掉了。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>似乎心情好轉，輕快地走掉了。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: L'air soulagée, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> s'éloigna d'un pas léger et gracieux.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: Erleichtert ging <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> mit leichten, anmutigen Schritten davon.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: Con un aire de alivio, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> se alejó con pasos ligeros y elegantes.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: Com um ar de alívio, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> se afastou com passos leves e graciosos.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ดูโล่งใจและเดินจากไปอย่างเบาสบาย
Data.UnitTalk_IND: Terlihat lega, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> berjalan pergi dengan langkah ringan dan anggun.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: Trông có vẻ nhẹ nhõm, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> bước đi với những bước chân nhẹ nhàng, duyên dáng.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: राहत महसूस करते हुए, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> हल्के कदमों से चली गई।

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>(이)가 자신의 최선은 고작 이 정도가 아니라며 부정했다.
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> insisted that she was capable of doing so much better.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は、自分のベストはこんなものではないと、否定した。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>否定说自己的极限不仅仅是这种程度。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>否定說自己的極限不僅僅是這種程度。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> insista qu'elle était capable de faire bien mieux.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> leugnete, dass dies ihr Bestes war.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> negó que su mejor esfuerzo fuera tan limitado.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> negou que seu melhor fosse tão pouco.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ยืนกรานว่าตัวเองทำได้ดีกว่านี้มาก
Data.UnitTalk_IND: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> menyangkal bahwa kemampuannya terbatas hanya sampai di sini.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> khăng khăng rằng cô ấy có thể làm tốt hơn nhiều.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ने इस बात से इनकार किया कि उसने अपना सर्वश्रेष्ठ प्रदर्शन किया था।

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 포션이 마음에 들었는지 <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>의 표정이 한층 밝아졌다.
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: Pleased with the potion, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>'s expression softened.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: ポーションが気に入ったのか、<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>の表情が一段と明るくなった。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 或许是药水很合她的心意，<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>的表情变得更加明亮了。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: 或許是藥水很合她的心意，<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>的表情變得更加明亮了。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: Satisfaite de la potion, l'expression de <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> s'éclaircit.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: Zufrieden mit dem Trank, wurde <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>s Ausdruck noch heller.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: Complacida con la poción, la expresión de <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> se iluminó.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: Satisfeita com a poção, a expressão de <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> se iluminou.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ดูพอใจกับยาเพิ่มพลังชีวิต สีหน้าของเธอจึงสดใสขึ้นมาก
Data.UnitTalk_IND: Senang dengan ramuan itu, ekspresi <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> menjadi lebih cerah.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: Hài lòng với bình thuốc, vẻ mặt của <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> trở nên rạng rỡ hơn.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: पोशन पसंद आने पर <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> का चेहरा खिल उठा।
